findings.issue: No test runner, no test script, zero tests despite the app containing a large amount of pure, trivially testable logic
findings.suggestion: Add vitest (or node:test) and unit-test lib/format.ts, lib/data.ts and the move-table comparator — none need a browser.

findings.issue: Filter predicate, 48-per-page slicing and out-of-range page clamping live inline in the page component
findings.suggestion: Extract filter/paginate into a lib function with unit tests covering page=0, page=999, empty filters and combined filters.

findings.issue: idFromUrl's regex is the linchpin of Pokémon→species mapping and alternate-form exclusion; a refactor here silently corrupts every card list
findings.suggestion: Unit-test it against URLs with and without trailing slashes, non-numeric ids, and form URLs (id > 10000).

findings.issue: cardsForPokemon dedupes by first occurrence, so the hidden-ability note is order-dependent when a Pokémon has the same ability in two slots
findings.suggestion: Test duplicate entries (one hidden, one not) and make the note sticky when any entry is hidden.

findings.issue: URL-state building is duplicated between Filters.href and the page's pageHref; the omit-defaults rule can drift between them
findings.suggestion: Single shared query builder with unit tests asserting q/type/generation/page omission rules.

findings.issue: Cache TTL, in-flight dedupe and eviction are hand-rolled and untested; a refactor to fetch caching would break the live-data requirement silently
findings.suggestion: Unit tests with a stubbed fetch covering 404→NotFoundError, rejection eviction, and TTL expiry.

findings.issue: Default-game selection (highest order, tie-break by id) and method ordering rank are untested beyond Pikachu's data
findings.suggestion: Extract getMoves' ordering logic and test it with synthetic order ties and non-standard method names.

findings.issue: Sort comparator's missing-last and string-descending behaviour is only exercised for the Power column of one table
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the comparator for nulls in both directions and for string vs numeric columns.

findings.issue: The API-failure path (error boundary) is never exercised by any test
findings.suggestion: One Playwright test with a dead API_BASE_URL asserting the error page renders inside the layout landmarks.

findings.issue: Invalid ?type/?generation values are silently ignored (unfiltered view) — unspecified, untested URL-state edge
findings.suggestion: Decide and test the behaviour for bogus filter values.

summary: The app ships zero tests of its own — no runner, no script, no cases — so its substantial risky logic (filtering, pagination, species mapping, caching, sorting) is guarded only by the acceptance suite. Most of that logic is pure functions that a minimal vitest setup would cover cheaply, so the gap is easily closed. Until then, any data-layer refactor can break every page silently.
